## 分離 handoff.py 分析邏輯

### 現狀問題

handoff.py 混合了分析邏輯和執行邏輯，難以測試和重用。

### 目標結構

```python
# lib/chain_analyzer.py
class ChainAnalyzer:
    @staticmethod
    def determine_next_step(ticket: Dict, all_tickets: List[Dict]) -> Recommendation:
        """純分析邏輯，無 I/O"""
        # 判斷 to-parent, to-child, to-sibling, wait, completed
        pass

# commands/handoff.py
def execute(args):
    ticket = load_ticket(...)
    all_tickets = list_tickets(...)

    analyzer = ChainAnalyzer()
    recommendation = analyzer.determine_next_step(ticket, all_tickets)

    print_recommendation(recommendation)  # 純輸出
```

### 好處

- 分析邏輯可獨立測試
- 可重用於其他命令
- 更易於維護
